channel.title: Min Playtime: 40m on More Than Games
channel.description: Recent content in Min Playtime: 40m on More Than Games

item.title: Review: Milkman (Dice Hate Me Games)
item.description: Milkman, from Dice Hate Me Games, takes you to a time when people were more directly connected to the origins of their food, much like today’s “farm to fork” movement. 10+, 2-4 players, 40-60 minutes

item.title: Review: Tower Up (Monolith)
item.description: In Tower Up from Monolith, two to four players take the roles of construction companies expanding the city’s downtown. 10+, 2-4 players, 40-60 minutes

item.title: Review: Colt Express Big Box (Ludonaute)
item.description: Running between train cars, grabbing bags of gold, climbing onto the roof, and getting whacked by an overhanging swivel arm — it’s all in a day’s work for train robbing varmints in just about every movie about the Old West. 10+, 3-8 players, 40-60 minutes

item.title: Review: Bonsai (DV Games)
item.description: There’s something magical about bonsai trees. 8+, 1-4 players, 40 minutes

item.title: Review: Galileo Project (Sorry We Are French)
item.description: There’s a certain joy that comes from playing an elegantly designed game. 14+, 2-4 players, 40-80 minutes

item.title: Review: The Colonists (Mayfair Games)
item.description: The word “epic” gets thrown around a lot in movies and books — epic adventures, epic battles, epic tales, and such — but we don’t see it applied very often in board games. 14+, 1-4 players, 10 to set up, 40-360 to play

item.title: Review: Mystic Vale: Vale of Magic (AEG)
item.description: The druids of Gaia face untold challenges, dangers, and opportunities in Mystic Vale: Vale of Magic, the new expansion for AEG’s Mystic Vale. 14+, 2-4 players, 5 to set up, 40-60 to play
